How to watch

NWSL+

NWSL+ streams live NWSL games, match recaps, and highlights. It’s free online, and on the NWSL+ app on Apple TV, Fire TV, and Roku.

CBS

CBS games can be watched on your local CBS affiliate (over-the-air or via cable/satellite). Streaming on Paramount+ is only available on the Paramount+ with SHOWTIME (Premium) plan. The cheaper Paramount+ Essentials plan does not include live local CBS streams.No matches are streaming-only on Paramount+. This is a change from prior seasons.

CBS Sports Network (CBSSN)

You typically need cable or streaming subscription to watch CBSSN. You can search for TV Providers by zipcode at the CBS Sports Network website.

Victory+

Victory+ is the newest streaming partner of the NWSL. It’s a free for live streaming and on-demand sports entertainment across major platforms.

After you’ve created a Victory+ account, you can download the Victory+ app on your smart TV and pair your account.
